report:
# DS-QM062-U1-SELECTOR-LAYERS

The real two-by-two representation aI+bJ realizes Gaussian multiplication and conjugation, and its norm polynomial is multiplicative. The source one_parameter_group_law assumes addition formulas and uses Nat-indexed integer circle points; that theorem is not a construction of continuous U(1) or field uniqueness.

Supported: Actual rational matrix products, Gaussian coefficients and norm-multiplicativity/conjugation polynomials are checked.

Remaining: Prove the full ring homomorphism/embedding and the R/C/H selection hypotheses, continuity and global uniqueness separately; algebraic controls do not exclude H by themselves.
